title: Governed Task Commit Closeout Requirement
user_authorization: add to governance a requirement to commit after each task
purpose: Require governed state-changing tasks to close with an intentional task-scoped Git commit after validation and textbook synchronization, while keeping dirty-worktree closeout failures explicit rather than silent.
enforced_invariants: Every governed task that changes repository state must end with an intentional Git commit before closeout.
The commit must be created only after required validation and textbook synchronization are complete.
The commit must cover the task-scoped governed delta rather than unrelated worktree residue.
If unrelated dirty state prevents an isolated commit, the task remains open and the blocker must be recorded explicitly.
Read-only audit tasks remain exempt because they do not modify governed state.

textbook_audit.result: The textbook mentions textbook synchronization and source_commit provenance, but no section projects governed task closeout policy in a way that required patching for this rule.

closeout_commit_status.reason: The repository already contains unrelated pending modifications across governed authority and output surfaces, so an isolated task-scoped closeout commit cannot be created safely within this turn.
